# Adventure with Makeda

> A family-centered children's story world by author Angel Washington. Makeda is a curious, joyful, kind-hearted girl whose adventures celebrate big dreams, strong roots, family, imagination, and kindness, guided by four values: Learn, Faith, Love, and Happiness.

Adventure with Makeda is a children's media property spanning illustrated storybooks, an official theme song, and future animation, music, learning, and play. The website is a static, installable web app at https://adventurewithmakeda.com.

## Pages
- [Adventure with Makeda](https://adventurewithmakeda.com/): Step into the Makeda Multiverse — five storybooks by Angel Washington, a theme song, and a world of family, friendship, imagination, and joy built on Learn, Faith, Love, and Happiness.
- [Our Story](https://adventurewithmakeda.com/story.html): Meet Makeda, her brother Apollo, and Faith the lion cub — and the heart behind Adventure with Makeda.
- [The Multiverse](https://adventurewithmakeda.com/world.html): Explore all five worlds of Adventure with Makeda: Welcome to Ethiopia, The Forest of Belonging, Auntie Rocky’s Legacy Garden, The Realm of Brilliant Minds, and Milo’s Magical Groove.
- [Makeda & Friends](https://adventurewithmakeda.com/characters.html): Meet Makeda, Sahara, Faith, Rocky, Milo, Apollo, and Kito — the family and friends of Adventure with Makeda.
- [Theme Song](https://adventurewithmakeda.com/song.html): Listen and sing along to the Adventure with Makeda theme song: learn, laugh, love, explore!
- [Parents & Partners](https://adventurewithmakeda.com/parents.html): Adventure with Makeda for families, press, publishers, licensing, and values-aligned partners.

## Books (the Makeda Multiverse)
- Book 1: Welcome to Ethiopia — Makeda points toward a golden city and waterfalls, walking beside Faith, her lion cub.
- Book 2: The Forest of Belonging — Makeda walks a mossy branch with a compass, a hummingbird, a pangolin and an otter.
- Book 3: Auntie Rocky’s Legacy Garden — Makeda writes in her journal in a blooming garden with Faith.
- Book 4: Apollo and the Realm of Brilliant Minds — Makeda and her brother Apollo ride Faith, a winged lion cub, over floating islands.
- Book 5: Milo’s Magical Groove — Makeda and her cousin Milo dance on a glowing treehouse stage full of music notes and forest friends.

## Characters
- Makeda (The curious explorer): Joyful, kind-hearted, and brave enough to step through every new door — and to bring others along. Her name means greatness.
- Sahara (Makeda’s best friend): One of Makeda’s closest friends, Sahara keeps every adventure fun — reminding her to laugh, loosen up, and not take things too seriously.
- Faith (The lion cub companion): Playful, loyal, and full of heart — Makeda’s best friend on every adventure.
- Rocky (Auntie Rocky): Her love lives on in every lesson, every dream, and every heart. Her garden teaches that love is the root of strong families.
- Milo (Makeda’s cousin): Music, dancing, and big-cousin energy — Milo helps everyone find their beat.
- Apollo (Makeda’s brother): A bright, big-hearted guide who knows that every kind of mind has something brilliant to give.
- Kito (Makeda’s bird friend): Bright feathers that shimmer like the sunset — Kito is always first to spot the way.
